notes: «حدثني عمي القاسم بن يحيى»: «عمي» with its name is one link, the name alone (rule 7)
Groups 2 to 4 are isnads after the saying, each its own group (rule 4); the text gives no compiler's shaykh for them, so none is filled in (rule 11)
«سمعت ابن عمر عن النبي ... بهذا» — «بهذا» is a note that the wording matches, not «بهذا الإسناد», so it is not written as a back_reference
«أخبرني أبو سلمة، أن أبا هريرة» — Abu Hurayra is the source Abu Salama heard from (rule 5)
